dog.description_text:
Looking to add a little extra warmth to your life? Meet Bouillon! True to his comforting name, this sweet and loving 2-year-old, 19 lb Pug is ready to win you over. Fosters report that he’s been a total gentleman in the home and seems to be house trained, having had no accidents during his stay.

With his sweet personality, Bouillon is ready to find a forever home where he can be your new best friend. Registered adopters interested in Bouillon can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
dog.name: Bouillon
